definitions.explanation: Secretly watching others, especially for sexual gratification. A formal, somewhat clinical term used in legal and psychological contexts.

examples.japanese: {窃視|せっし}は{犯罪|はんざい}になりうる。
{窃視|せっし}{症|しょう}という{言葉|ことば}を{聞|き}いた。
{窃視|せっし}{行為|こうい}は、{相手|あいて}の{尊厳|そんげん}を{傷|きず}つける{重大|じゅうだい}な{問題|もんだい}だ。
examples.english: Voyeuristic acts are a serious problem that violates the victim's dignity.

notes:
Compound of {窃|せつ} (to do secretly, as in {窃盗|せっとう} theft) and {視|し} (to look, see). A formal, technical word; can be used with する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {窃視|せっし}{症|しょう}: voyeuristic disorder (clinical term)
- {窃視|せっし}{行為|こうい}: voyeuristic acts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- のぞき: peeping — the everyday, colloquial word
- {覗|のぞ}き{見|み}: peeking, peeping — neutral, not necessarily sexual
